title: Recurrence in Buccinator Muscle Excision With the Skin Versus Without the Skin in Buccal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
brief_summary: Evaluation of local control in buccinator muscle excision with the skin versus buccinator muscle excision without the skin in buccal squamous cell carcinoma: A randomized clinical trial.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients suffering from buccal squamous cell carcinoma.
* Patients should be free from any systemic disease that may affect normal healing, and predictable outcome.
* Both sexes and all ages will be included in the study.
* Cooperative patients, who accept the procedure and return for follow up , examination and evaluation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with any systemic disease that may affect normal healing.9,10
* Patients who physically and psychologically not able to tolerate the procedures.
* Patients may discontinue the follow up.
condition: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oral Cavity
